text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce and heated race, Grass<n>Wonder
comes out on top!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Victory is hers, but she can't find the<n>words to
describe the feeling. All she<n>can do is bask in the
afterglow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Now she looks ahead to her second,<n>more focused
shot at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, who was spectating<n>today's race, is
left speechless by<n>her friends' ever-growing
abilities. As<n>she stares on in shock, Maruzensky
approaches her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Maruzensky's words,<n>Special Week
breaks through her<n>complex feelings and runs off,
inspiration rekindled.
